title: IRDAI Approves ProTec General Insurance License & Operationalises Policyholders' Education Fund (PEPF)
summary: Grants 4th general insurance license of 2026 and replaces periodic intermediary renewals with perpetual registration.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 IRDAI Approves ProTec General Insurance License & Operationalises Policyholders' Education Fund (PEPF). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Grants 4th general insurance license of 2026 and replaces periodic intermediary renewals with perpetual registration.
License Awardee: ProTec General Insurance Ltd (JV between M.
Pallonji Group & True North's Divya Sehgal).
Regulatory Reforms: Operationalised PEPF under Sec 16A of IRDA Act 1999; mandated salesperson tagging on policies; replaced periodic intermediary renewals with annual fee perpetual registration.

FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) Threshold: 2 insurers (1 life, 1 general) increased foreign shareholding beyond 74% following 100% FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) clearance.
100% FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake) in insurance vs earlier 74% foreign shareholding cap.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
